Alice — thanks for the manifest. A few items from Redwood's side before we can sign off on the acceptance window:

1) Operator acceptance checklist: we need the operator to present both (a) the courier token and (b) the operator PIV. If you could confirm courier badge scans are available that covers (a).
2) HSM wrap verification: please include the KMS key-id and the signing certificate chain inside the manifest. We will validate the cert chain against our trust store (we only accept certs chained to our vetted CA roots).
3) TPM/host attestation: the operator runbook must include a short attestation step that the target appliance returns a TPM quote for the image hash (or an equivalent secure-boot measurement) prior to activation.
4) Isolation test: before activating on the islanded rack, we want a lab activation run in our staging lab (same appliance model) to exercise the activation script and the rollback path. Can EdgeCorp schedule a test delivery (no courier) for Nov 10?

Assuming the above checks pass, we can sign off on Nov 8 09:00-11:00 PST. Please send the chain-of-custody token link and the HSM key-id + cert chain as attachments or secure links. Attached outbound: operator-checklist-v1.xlsx (checklist version with fields for operator name, badge id, TPM quote, hash checksum).

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Security & Compliance 
Redwood Inference
